en.name: Actor
en.ability: All good players (except travellers) know each other, are drunk and can not change alignment. Win/lose condition is reversed, even if you lose your ability.

revisions.v1: Win/lose condition is reversed, even if you are dead. All Actors know each other. [All good players are Actors]
revisions.v2: All good players (except travellers) know each other, are drunk and can not change alignment. Win/lose condition is reversed, even if you lose your ability.

zh.name: 戏子
zh.ability: 其他善良玩家醉酒（旅行者除外），你们互相认识且无法转变阵营，对调胜负结果，即使你失去能力。

revisions.v1: 所有戏子互相认识。不论在场的戏子数量多少或存活与否，胜负结果会被对调。[所有善良玩家都是戏子]
